mapper.sql: ID, CREATOR, CREATE_TIME, MODIFIER, MODIFY_TIME, LOGIC_DEL, REC_VER, BUILD_IN, TENANT_ID, USER_ID, HEADER_ID, MIDDLE_ID, TITLE, `NAME`, ENABLED, FIXED, ELLIPSIS_TOOLTIP, WIDTH, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH, ORDER_NUM, SORTED, RESIZE_FLAG
mapper.select: SELECT DETAIL.ID, DETAIL.CREATOR, DETAIL.CREATE_TIME, DETAIL.MODIFIER, DETAIL.MODIFY_TIME, DETAIL.LOGIC_DEL, DETAIL.REC_VER, DETAIL.BUILD_IN, DETAIL.TENANT_ID, DETAIL.USER_ID, DETAIL.HEADER_ID, DETAIL.MIDDLE_ID, DETAIL.TITLE, DETAIL.NAME, DETAIL.ENABLED, DETAIL.FIXED, DETAIL.ELLIPSIS_TOOLTIP, DETAIL.WIDTH, DETAIL.MIN_WIDTH, DETAIL.MAX_WIDTH, DETAIL.ORDER_NUM, DETAIL.SORTED, DETAIL.RESIZE_FLAG FROM sys_column_header HEADER LEFT JOIN sys_column_middle MIDDLE ON MIDDLE.HEADER_ID = HEADER.ID AND MIDDLE.ENABLED = 1 AND MIDDLE.LOGIC_DEL = 0 LEFT JOIN SYS_COLUMN_DETAIL DETAIL ON DETAIL.HEADER_ID = HEADER.ID AND MIDDLE_ID = MIDDLE.ID WHERE DETAIL.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND DETAIL.USER_ID = #{userId} AND DETAIL.HEADER_ID = #{headerId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SYS_COLUMN_DETAIL ( ID, CREATOR, CREATE_TIME, MODIFIER, MODIFY_TIME, LOGIC_DEL, REC_VER, BUILD_IN, TENANT_ID, USER_ID, HEADER_ID, MIDDLE_ID, TITLE, NAME, ENABLED, FIXED, ELLIPSIS_TOOLTIP, WIDTH, MIN_WIDTH, MAX_WIDTH, ORDER_NUM, SORTED, RESIZE_FLAG ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.creator}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.modifier}, #{item.modifyTime}, #{item.logicDel}, #{item.recVer}, #{item.buildIn}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.headerId}, #{item.middleId}, #{item.title}, #{item.name}, #{item.enabled}, #{item.fixed}, #{item.ellipsisTooltip}, #{item.width}, #{item.minWidth}, #{item.maxWidth}, #{item.orderNum}, #{item.sorted}, #{item.resizeFlag}
